title: cynoglossospermum virginicum
intro: Cynoglossospermum virginicum, commonly known as American bugleweed or American water-hemlock, is a perennial plant native to North America. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and insomnia, due to its therapeutic actions as an antispasmodic and anxiolytic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, caution should be exercised when handling the plant, as it is also known to be toxic in large quantities due to its presence of cicutoxin.
